note: Hidde 2026-09-03: 'verstuur'. Thanks for the Birkelunden photographs, the licence question their own letter raises (they did not take them), the app now that it is live, and one tree question.

mails.subject: Re: Svar på ønsker bilder av trær til ancienttrees app - Munch-eika og bjørketrær i Birkelunden
mails.body:
Hi Bianca,

Thanks, this helps a lot. Oslo has no photograph on our page at all yet, so the Birkelunden pictures would be the first.

One thing before I use one: you say they were not taken by you. May I publish it credited to Ingar Sørensen, or should I ask him myself first?

Our app is also live now, with Oslo in it. I would like to know what you think of it.
https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/ancient-trees/id6806177833?l=en-GB

And is there an Oslo tree we should not be missing? We publish four.

Thanks either way,
Hidde
https://ancienttrees.app/oslo
mails.resend_reason: They answered our 2026-08-10 mail on 2026-09-03 with three Birkelunden photographs; this thanks them and asks the licence question their own letter raises.
